meta.title: InstantMilega: local help and work in minutes | KaamMilega
meta.description: Book a verified worker nearby or get work alerts near you, with live tracking and start and finish codes. Coming soon in the KaamMilega app for Android and iOS.

hero.textHire: Book a verified worker nearby, see them coming on the map, and pay in the app.
hero.textWork: Turn on Free now, get work alerts from customers nearby, and withdraw your earnings instantly.

how.textHire: Four steps from request to finished job.
how.textWork: Four steps from sign-up to money in your bank.

choose.title: Choose a service
choose.text: Pick what you need and share your location.

match.title: Get matched
match.text: Choose a worker yourself, or let the app send it to the best-rated worker nearby.

start.title: Start code on arrival
start.text: Track them on the map. When they arrive, share your start code.

finish.title: Finish code and pay
finish.text: When the work is done, share your finish code and pay in the app. You get a bill.

verify.title: Get verified
verify.text: Add Aadhaar, PAN and bank details. Our team checks them the same day.

free.title: Go Free now
free.text: Turn on Free now when you are ready, and get alerts for work near you.

accept.title: Accept in 120 seconds
accept.text: See the work, the place and the pay. Accept it and head to the customer.

paid.title: Get paid
paid.text: The finish code closes the job. Your money lands in your wallet; withdraw it instantly.

alert.title: 120 seconds to respond
alert.text: Each request goes to one worker at a time. If they do not accept in 120 seconds, it moves to the next.

codes.title: Start and finish codes
codes.text: Work starts only with the customer’s start code and closes only with their finish code.

live.title: Live map
live.text: Follow the worker on the way to you, like a cab ride.

eta.title: Arrival time
eta.text: See when they will reach, for example "Arriving in 10 min".

call.title: Chat and call
call.text: Talk in the app, or call their number once the booking is confirmed.

alerts.title: Instant alerts
alerts.text: Workers hear about new work nearby even when the app is closed.

services.title: Launching with
services.text: More services will follow after launch.

verified.title: Verified workers
verified.text: Aadhaar, PAN and bank checked by our team, with at least 2 years of experience.

rating.title: Better rated first
rating.text: Higher-rated workers get your request first, even if a little farther away.

paid.title: Paid in the app
paid.text: Online payment only, with a bill for every job.

support.title: Help when you need it
support.text: Support by in-app chat, phone and WhatsApp.

pass.title: One pass for all of KaamMilega
pass.text: The same pass for customers and workers. No commission on the service itself.
pass.limit: 10 bookings or gigs, or 90 days, whichever comes first
pass.counts: Every booking counts, even a cancelled one; unused ones lapse
pass.refund: Full refund if you have not used it

languages.title: In your language, across India
languages.text: Use the app in any of these languages.

whyApp.a: InstantMilega needs your live location for matching, alerts and tracking, which works reliably only in the app. Jobs, skills, experts and events stay on the website as they are. <link>Browse jobs</link>

launch.a: Soon, on Android and iOS. Leave your number on this page and we will tell you the day it is live.

cost.a: Creating a profile, looking around and your first 3 chats are free. Booking or taking work needs the ₹99 pass. KaamMilega takes no commission on the service itself; if a small platform fee applies, you see it before you confirm.

noAccept.a: Each worker gets 120 seconds, then the request moves on. If nobody is free, you can pick another time or offer a higher rate.

cancel.a: Before a worker accepts, you get a full refund. Once they are on the way, a small fee goes to the worker; after they arrive, a visit fee. Cancelled bookings count towards your pass.

parts.a: Parts or extra material are paid to the worker directly. The service itself is paid online in the app.

oneAccount.q: Can I hire and work from the same account?
oneAccount.a: Yes. One KaamMilega account lets you hire, work and find jobs; switch between Hire and Work at the top of the app.

closing.title: Be the first to know
closing.text: The KaamMilega app is coming to Android and iOS. Hire, work and find jobs from one account.
